answer: Because the oasis pair is tracked in the zephyr ledger, the vertex audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward requires answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 43%. Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 145 identities means 145 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
